positive.sql:
SELECT person.name
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person_order.person_id = person.id
JOIN menu ON person_order.menu_id = menu.id
WHERE person.gender = 'female' AND menu.pizza_name = 'pepperoni pizza'
INTERSECT
SELECT person.name
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person_order.person_id = person.id
JOIN menu ON person_order.menu_id = menu.id
WHERE person.gender = 'female' AND menu.pizza_name = 'cheese pizza'
ORDER BY name;

negative.why: COUNT(*) вместо DISTINCT: попадёт тот, кто дважды заказал одну пиццу
negative.sql:
SELECT person.name
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person_order.person_id = person.id
JOIN menu ON person_order.menu_id = menu.id
WHERE person.gender = 'female'
  AND (menu.pizza_name = 'pepperoni pizza' OR menu.pizza_name = 'cheese pizza')
GROUP BY person.id, person.name
HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
ORDER BY person.name;

negative.why: условие HAVING < 2: попали те, кто заказал только одну
negative.sql:
SELECT person.name
FROM person_order
JOIN person ON person_order.person_id = person.id
JOIN menu ON person_order.menu_id = menu.id
WHERE person.gender = 'female'
  AND (menu.pizza_name = 'pepperoni pizza' OR menu.pizza_name = 'cheese pizza')
GROUP BY person.id, person.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT menu.pizza_name) < 2
ORDER BY person.name;

SELECT DISTINCT person.name FROM person_order JOIN person ON person_order.person_id = person.id JOIN menu ON person_order.menu_id = menu.id WHERE person.gender = 'female' AND (menu.pizza_name = 'pepperoni pizza' OR menu.pizza_name = 'cheese pizza') ORDER BY person.name;
